dialogue.origin: こちら、「カウンセラー・希死念慮」です。よろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: This is the 'Counselor for Suicidal Ideation' service. I look forward to working with you.

dialogue.origin: わかりました。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Okay. You too.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは 相談員です。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm the counselor. Nice to meet you.
Yes.
I just want to die already.

dialogue.origin: なるほど…そう思われるほど、お辛く思われれているのですね、
dialogue.content: I see... You must be in so much pain to feel that way.
Yeah.

dialogue.origin: 教えてくれてありがとうございますどんなことがあったのか…詳しく聞いてもいいですか？
dialogue.content: Thank you for telling me. Would it be alright if I asked you more about what's been happening?

dialogue.origin: お答えになれる範囲で構いませんよ
dialogue.content: You only need to share what you're comfortable with.

dialogue.origin: 母も父も私を家族と思ってないの
dialogue.content: My mom and dad don't think of me as part of the family.
Mm-hmm, mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: 続けてくださいね言える範囲で、大丈夫ですから
dialogue.content: Please continue, as much as you feel you can. It's okay.

dialogue.origin: お兄ちゃんやおねえちゃんばかり
dialogue.content: It’s all about my older brother and sister.
I see.

dialogue.origin: 私は家族の中で一番成績よくないから
dialogue.content: Because I have the worst grades in the family.
Mm-hmm, mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: お兄ちゃんもお姉ちゃんもいい大学行ってる
dialogue.content: My brother and sister both went to good universities.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね自分だけ低い…そう考えると、辛くなってしまいますよね、
dialogue.content: I see. Thinking that you're the only one who falls short... that must be very painful.

dialogue.origin: 私は二人のようじゃないから
dialogue.content: Because I'm not like them.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね。今日は少しでも気持ちが楽になるように…
dialogue.content: I understand. Today, I hope we can help you feel even a little bit better...

dialogue.origin: 一緒に、ぜひ考えさせて欲しいです。
dialogue.content: I'd really like us to think about this together.
Okay.

dialogue.origin: 今日は、なんて呼べばいいですか？本名じゃなくても構いませんよ
dialogue.content: What would you like me to call you today? It doesn’t have to be your real name.
It's Sayo.

dialogue.origin: さよさんですね。ありがとうございます今は学生さんですか？
dialogue.content: Sayo, I see. Thank you. Are you a student right now?
Yes.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね、ありがとうございます。寒くなってきてますね。今はちゃんと暖かくされてますか？
dialogue.content: I see, thank you. It's getting colder, isn't it? Are you keeping warm right now?

dialogue.origin: 今、外お兄ちゃんもお姉ちゃんも両親が希望した大学いったの
dialogue.content: I'm outside right now. My brother and sister both went to the universities our parents wanted them to go to.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。希望した大学に行った…
dialogue.content: I see. They went to the universities your parents wanted...
I don't want to be at home.
Yeah.

dialogue.origin: 家だと、色々と、考えてしまいますものね。
dialogue.content: When you're at home, you end up thinking about all sorts of things, don't you?
There's no place for me there.

dialogue.origin: そうなんだ…それは辛いよね。いたくないよね。
dialogue.content: I see... That must be so hard. Of course you wouldn't want to be there.

dialogue.origin: お母さんもお父さんも冷たい目で見るし
dialogue.content: My mom and dad look at me with such cold eyes.
I see.
I hate them.

dialogue.origin: そうなんだね。冷たい目で見られて居場所がなかったら…
dialogue.content: I understand. If they look at you with cold eyes and you feel like you have no place...

dialogue.origin: つらくなるのも全然おかしいことじゃないと思います
dialogue.content: It's completely normal to feel hurt by that.
I'm not a doll.
That must have been so hard.
Mm-hmm.
Yeah.
Your parents...
I don't want to go home.

dialogue.origin: そうだよね。ご両親は、行って欲しかった大学に行けなかったから冷たくしてる？
dialogue.content: I understand. Are your parents being cold because you didn't go to the university they wanted?
Yeah.

dialogue.origin: おまえはバカだからって
dialogue.content: They say it's because I'm stupid.
What?!

dialogue.origin: そんな風に言われたら嫌だよね、、
dialogue.content: Being told something like that must feel awful.

dialogue.origin: この大学にも入れないのかって
dialogue.content: They say things like, 'You can’t even get into this university?'

dialogue.origin: 私はどうしょうもない子って
dialogue.content: They say I'm a hopeless child.

dialogue.origin: 今までもいうことはきがないと、どうしょうもない子って
dialogue.content: Even before, if I didn't do what they said, they'd call me a hopeless child.
What should I do?
I have nowhere to go.

dialogue.origin: 死んだ方がいいと思う
dialogue.content: I think it’d be better if I were dead.

dialogue.origin: （システム復旧確認メッセージ）
dialogue.content: (System recovery confirmation message)

dialogue.origin: （テストです。LINEは届いていますか？
dialogue.content: (This is a test. Are you receiving these LINE messages?)
OK.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。間も無く再開します
dialogue.content: Thank you. We will resume shortly.
Resuming-------
Okay.

dialogue.origin: そう思ってしまうくらい、つらいんですよね
dialogue.content: It's so painful that you've started to think that way, isn't it?
Yeah.

dialogue.origin: みんな私がいなくてもいいと思ってるよ
dialogue.content: Everyone thinks it would be fine if I weren't here.

dialogue.origin: 怖いよね。1人になった気持ちになっちゃうよね。
dialogue.content: That's scary. It makes you feel all alone.
Because I am alone.

dialogue.origin: そんなにつらかったのに、こうやって相談してくれたんだね勇気があると思う。改めて、教えてくれてありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Even though it's been so hard for you, you still reached out for help like this. I think that took a lot of courage. Thank you again for sharing that with me.
Courage?

dialogue.origin: うん…。辛いと、誰かに話すの、怖くなったりしないかな
dialogue.content: Yes... When things are hard, it can feel scary to talk to someone, can’t it?
I don't know.
I have no place to go home to.
Mm-hmm.
It's the end of the year, and with COVID...
I can't even see my friends.

dialogue.origin: そうだよね、居場所がないのは嫌だよね、追い詰められてしまうよね。。
dialogue.content: Right, not having a place where you belong is so hard. It makes you feel cornered.
It must be nice.
For everyone else...
Your family...

dialogue.origin: 普通に、受け止めてくれたらいいのに、って思う？
dialogue.content: Do you wish they would just accept you as you are?
Yeah.
I understand.

dialogue.origin: よかったら…おうちに居場所を持てるように
dialogue.content: If you'd like... so that you can feel like you have a place at home...
Okay.

dialogue.origin: 一緒に何か方法を考えさせて欲しいです。どうかな…？
dialogue.content: I'd like for us to think of a way forward, together. What do you think...?
Yeah, okay.
Thank you.

dialogue.origin: ご両親からは、それからずっと冷たくされちゃうの？
dialogue.content: Have your parents been cold to you ever since then?
Since I was little.
Because I’m a failure.

dialogue.origin: そうか、そんな前から…つらかったよね。。
dialogue.content: I see, since you were that young... that must have been so hard.

dialogue.origin: 大学に入る前も、成績のこととか言われてた
dialogue.content: Even before entering university, they said things about your grades...
...is that right?
Yes.
I was always being yelled at.
Mm-hmm, mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: こんな成績情けないって
dialogue.content: They'd say my grades were pathetic.

dialogue.origin: こんな成績、って。。そんな風に言われたらそれは嫌になっても仕方ないよ。。しかもずっと、、
dialogue.content: 'Pathetic grades'... It's no wonder you'd feel awful being told that. And for it to have been going on for so long, too...
Sayo,
Yeah.
how do you feel about studying? Do you like it?
I hate it.

dialogue.origin: そうだよね、ずっと怖かったもんね。
dialogue.content: I can understand that. It's been a source of fear for so long.
I studied as hard as I could.

dialogue.origin: そうなんだねそれでもずっと、勉強してきたんだね
dialogue.content: I see. And even so, you've kept studying all this time.

dialogue.origin: 嫌いだったし、怖かったのに。負けなかったんだね。
dialogue.content: Even though you hated it and it was scary, you didn't give up.

dialogue.origin: でもお兄ちゃんやお姉ちゃんと違うもん
dialogue.content: But I'm different from my brother and sister.

dialogue.origin: うん…どれだけ頑張っても…
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm... no matter how hard you tried...

dialogue.origin: あのレベルの大学にはいけないの
dialogue.content: I can't get into a university at their level.

dialogue.origin: お兄さんやお姉さんも、さよさんには冷たい？
dialogue.content: Are your brother and sister also cold to you, Sayo?
A little.
Really?

dialogue.origin: お姉ちゃんもお兄ちゃんもいいなりだから
dialogue.content: My sister and brother just do whatever they’re told.
I see... whatever your parents say?
Yeah.
I see...

dialogue.origin: 二人共ご自慢の子供だから
dialogue.content: They are both the pride and joy of our parents.
Mm-hmm.
It's hard for me to be there.

dialogue.origin: 辛いよね…ご両親は、勉強以外でもずっと冷たい？
dialogue.content: That's painful... Are your parents always cold, even about things other than studying?
Pretty much.
That's why I hate it!

dialogue.origin: そうだよね。死にたいと思うから、嫌なんだよね
dialogue.content: I understand. You hate it so much that you want to die.
Yeah.

dialogue.origin: こんな家にいたくないよ
dialogue.content: I don’t want to be in a home like this.
Yes, I understand...
Sayo, right now...
are you a third-year high school student?

dialogue.origin: すみません。ここで終了させていただきます
dialogue.content: I'm sorry. We'll have to end the session here.

topic.sub: 親との冷たい関係問題
